How to boot a computer from your phone
Boot menu keys for common brands, and what to try if it doesn\'t start.
1. Mount an image in the Drive tab and plug the phone into the computer.
2. Restart the computer and keep pressing its boot menu key as it starts:
3. Pick “BootStik” followed by the image name. Some menus just say USB or UEFI: USB.
If it doesn\'t show up or won\'t start:
• Windows ISOs only boot as a CD-ROM. Most Linux ISOs work as a read-only USB disk.
• Some ISOs need Secure Boot switched off in the computer\'s firmware settings.
• Plug straight into the computer rather than through a hub, and use a cable that carries data.
• Apple silicon Macs can\'t boot from these images.

Brand matters less than three things: Android 8 or newer, root, and a kernel built with USB mass storage. That covers most phones from 2018 on, from Motorola, Samsung, Xiaomi, OnePlus and others. Some kernels leave mass storage out, and BootStick tells you if yours is one of them.
Motorola ThinkPhone 2023: Android 14, GKI 5.10 kernel, KernelSU Next, connected to a Mac.
Android 7 and older, phones without root, and kernels without USB mass storage. Downloads, image checks and blank images still work on these.
